title: The Song Nobody Could Finish
central_conflict: the school band and choir kept landing on different notes at the finale
decisive_choice: the brass players had been given a score transposed for a different instrument
resolution: printed the correct parts and rehearsed the ending with everyone together
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered the school band and choir kept landing on different notes at the finale during a power outage, leaving the community helpers waiting.
Rabbit tried to isolate the problem first, but they rehearsed each section separately but the final chord still clashed; fox stopped the attempt before further damage.
Fox compared the failed attempt with the evidence and realized the brass players had been given a score transposed for a different instrument; they planned a safer joint response.
With the community helpers watching, they printed the correct parts and rehearsed the ending with everyone together, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

title: The Celebration Held on the Wrong Day
central_conflict: half the town arrived for a holiday feast while the tables were still being built
decisive_choice: the invitation printer had mixed day-month and month-day date formats
resolution: sent corrected invitations with the month written out and held one shared feast
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered half the town arrived for a holiday feast while the tables were still being built during a power outage, leaving the community helpers waiting.
Rabbit tried to isolate the problem first, but they reread the invitations but each group insisted its date was correct; fox stopped the attempt before further damage.
Fox compared the failed attempt with the evidence and realized the invitation printer had mixed day-month and month-day date formats; they planned a safer joint response.

With the community helpers watching, they sent corrected invitations with the month written out and held one shared feast, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

title: The Stage That Leaned During the Dance
central_conflict: the floating festival stage tilted whenever the performers gathered
decisive_choice: the equipment and audience had all been placed on the same side of the pontoons
resolution: closed the stage for a balanced-load inspection and reopened after a safe test
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered the floating festival stage tilted whenever the performers gathered during a power outage, leaving the community helpers waiting.
Rabbit tried to isolate the problem first, but they tightened the stage ropes but it leaned further with every dancer; fox stopped the attempt before further damage.
Fox compared the failed attempt with the evidence and realized the equipment and audience had all been placed on the same side of the pontoons; they planned a safer joint response.

With the community helpers watching, they closed the stage for a balanced-load inspection and reopened after a safe test, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.
